about: Claim-to-source record for the M5 Guardian website. Every factual statement the page makes about the device is listed with the website file that says it and a verbatim quotation from a repository file that supports it. Paths are relative to the repository root (sources) or to website/ (page). Status: current = what the device does now; host-only = validated by host tests, not on the device; deferred = not built yet. The page itself is a simulation: its moods, scenarios, names and counts are labelled demo or example values, not readings. lib/claims.test.ts checks that every page snippet and every quotation is still present.

claims.statement: A security change of the owner's router is amber by default until accepted on the Details page, a channel move is one grey line, and the Router changes setting picks Details only, Amber or Strict; implemented and host-tested, not run on the stick (G25).

page.text: Router changes: when your own router changes its advertised security settings, for example after an update or a restart, the stick shows what changed in amber, and “a downgrade” when it got weaker, until you accept it on the Details page. A router that only moves channel is followed silently, as one grey line on the details page. The ROUTER CHANGES setting picks the colour: Details only (no colour), Amber (the default) or Strict (a security change is the red ALERT until you accept it). This is implemented and host-tested; it has not run on the stick yet.
